reference.title: Password Security Best Practices
reference.shortdesc: Password security recommendations, including password length, uniqueness, password manager use, and multifactor authentication.

section.title: Core Password Standards for NC State Accounts
section.p: Following CISA password guidance helps all NC State students, faculty, and staff protect university systems and personal accounts from unauthorized access:

ul.li: Make passwords long: Use passwords that are at least 16 characters long (longer is stronger).

Keep passwords random: Use a passphrase of five to seven unrelated words, or a random mix of uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. Avoid personal details such as pet names or family birthdays.
Use unique passwords for every account: Never reuse your NC State Unity ID password on external websites or personal accounts.
Change default passwords: Always replace out-of-the-box default usernames and passwords on new devices, routers, and software before use.

section.title: Recommended Security Tools

ul.li: Password manager: Use a trusted password manager to generate complex passwords, store them securely, and fill them in automatically so you only need to remember one strong master password.
Multifactor authentication (MFA): Pair strong passwords with Duo two-factor authentication (2FA) so a stolen password alone cannot compromise your account.

section.note: Learn more about federal password recommendations in the CISA Require Strong Passwords guide.
